snippet.title: Endless Legend - Auriga Supplication - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Endless Legend is a 4X turn-based fantasy strategy game by the creators of Endless Space and Dungeon of the Endless. Control every aspect of your civilization as you struggle to save your homeworld Auriga. Create your own Legend!

Endless Legend Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/289130/
Endless Legend Website: http://g2g.amplitude-studios.com/Games/Endless-Legend
Name of the music: Secession Studio - Wake of the Martyrs
